profile.ja:
12の魔界騎士のひとり。銀竜騎士団団長。
魔界の歴史の闇に潜む正体不明の美女。
深い憎悪と絶望を持つ者を好み、虚無へと誘う。
テウタテスに力を与え、魔界では戦争を、東京キングダムでは動乱と虐殺を演出した。
profile.en: [INTRO] One of the twelve Demon Realm knights and commander of the Silver Dragon Knights. A mysterious beauty lurking in the shadows of the Demon Realm's history. She favors those who harbor deep hatred and despair, luring them into nothingness. She empowered Teutates, orchestrating war in the Demon Realm and chaos and slaughter in the Tokyo Kingdom.

text.ja: 仮初の共闘に名乗りが必要か？　さて、お前は我をどれほど愉しませてくれるのか……見ものだな。フフフッ……
text.en: [VOICE/Acquired] Do you really need a name for this temporary alliance? Well then, how much will you amuse me… It'll be entertaining. Heh heh…

text.ja: 馬のことか？　あぁ、戦闘の際には使う。どこへでも駆け出し、誰であろうと轢いてみせよう。お前もうかうかしていると轢いてしまうぞ？
text.en: [VOICE/Home] You mean a horse? Ah, I use them in battle. They'll charge anywhere, and I'll trample anyone, no matter who they are. If you're dawdling, I'll just step on you, got it?

text.ja: ……虚無とはなにか、か。フン、お前に理解ができるとは到底思えぬ。なぜか、と？　お前は、それからもっとも遠い存在だからだ
text.en: [VOICE/Home] …What is nothingness, huh? Hmph, I doubt you could ever understand it. Why? Because you're the furthest thing from it.

text.ja: 我が槍はすべてを薙ぎ払う。そう……我以外のすべて、だ。敵も味方もありはせぬ。我の道を阻むものは、平等に斬り伏せるのみ
text.en: [VOICE/Home] My spear sweeps everything away. That means everything except me. There are no enemies or allies. Anything that blocks my path will be cut down equally.

text.ja: 誰かが言った、この世界は愉快なものに満ち溢れている、と。我にはそうは思えぬ。退屈で愚鈍な者どもばかりだ。……一部を除いて、な
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Someone once said this world is full of delightful things. I don't think so. It's full of boring, dull beings… except for a few.

text.ja: お前もせいぜい、そばに置くべき者については吟味しておけよ？　いつ、誰が寝首を掻こうとしてくるかわからぬものだ。フフッ……
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Even you should be picky about who you keep close, alright? You never know when or who might try to slit your throat. Heh heh…

text.ja: 自身が盤上の駒となるか、その駒を動かす側になるのか……。お前はどちらを好む？　フフッ、そうか。では、我は……どちらだと思う？
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Will you become a piece on the board, or the one who moves the pieces…? Which do you prefer? Heh heh, I see. Then, what do you think I'll choose?

text.ja: 希望も夢も、やがては腐り落ちる。……結末はただひとつ、虚無だ。ならば、初めから虚無に酔いしれればいい……そうだろう？　フフッ
text.en: [VOICE/Home] Hope and dreams will eventually rot. …There's only one ending: nothingness. So, why not drown in nothingness from the start… right? Heh heh.
